method.coordinate_validity: finite latitude 40-84 N and longitude 142-52 W; the -1/-1 sentinel is reported separately
method.coverage_rule: direct_fit if n_trees>=100 and n_plots>=5; pooled_fit if not direct and (30<=n_trees<100 or 2<=n_plots<5); otherwise no_data
method.plot_definition: physical plot unit: FAIB plot prefix from tree_id, MAGPlot/WFS ground-plot prefix from visit_id, QC PEP and NL FAL site_id
method.spatial_join: EPSG:4326 points transformed to EPSG:3978; predicate=within
method.tree_support_definition: live status with finite DBH in (0, 500] cm; n_tree_rows retains all tree records for the species
